sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach come into this fixture off the back of a recent loss, though their overall record remains strong with seven wins from their last six outings. Alsager sit bottom of the division with just four points and arrive in poor form, having won only once all season, making this a favorable matchup for the league leaders.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their own recent loss and close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two strong-performing sides—Eccleshall have won their last game and sit fifth, while Bridgnorth have recovered from consecutive losses with recent wins. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table and in good form, visit Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday before facing Brereton Social away on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town, sixth with impressive recent form, travel to Foley Meir on Saturday in what should be a competitive mid-table encounter. Barnton host Shawbury United on Saturday; Shawbury are in severe form trouble with five consecutive losses, while Barnton have steadied themselves recently. Market Drayton Town face New Mills at home on Saturday—both teams occupy mid-to-lower positions with inconsistent form. Crewe host Allscott Heath on Saturday in a basement-area battle, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town; both sides have struggled significantly this season. Finally, Brereton Social (currently on poor form with multiple losses) host Widnes Town on Saturday—Widnes are bottom of the league with just two points and have lost five of their last six games.
